generator_output.user_prompt: We need to process an engineering change request for one of our key products that involves design modifications and supply chain validation. The change impacts multiple departments, so we'll need to coordinate the assessment across product design, manufacturing, and procurement to evaluate resource requirements and timeline implications. As part of this, we also need to identify which customer accounts are affected by this change so we can incorporate them into our communication strategy and any related marketing outreach. Can you help us orchestrate this entire workflow from initial change submission through cross-functional impact analysis and stakeholder notification?
